title: Substituting in other bands, drum technique, advertising and dance permits
summary: One long block: substituting with Buddy Petit, Kid Howard and others; controlling tempo as drummer; the old bass drum cymbal attachment; loud advertising on trucks; the New York band; permits then and now.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
